front.title: The X402 Typed Settlement Wire Protocol (X402-TSWP)

abstract.t: This document specifies the X402 Typed Settlement Wire Protocol (X402-TSWP), an application-layer framing extension to HTTP status code 402 (Payment Required). It defines machine-to-machine challenge-response headers, a typed discriminator registry, and byte-exact multi-rail blockchain settlement grammars. The protocol is deployed in production with sub-400 ms cross-border finality.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: reserves HTTP 402 for future use. X402-TSWP provides a deterministic, multi-rail settlement protocol with atomic PTB pipelines.

The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "REQUIRED", "SHALL", "SHALL NOT", "SHOULD", "SHOULD NOT", "RECOMMENDED", "NOT RECOMMENDED", "MAY", and "OPTIONAL" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: The X402-TSWP Wire Grammar
section.sourcecode: x402-payload = "X402" type-tag [ ":" sub-type ] ":" payload type-tag = ALPHA ; Uppercase A-Z sub-type = ALPHA ; Optional qualifier payload = 1*128( VCHAR ) ; Printable ASCII

section.name: Server Challenge (402 Payment Required)
section.sourcecode: HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required WWW-Authenticate: X402-TSWP challenge="827da995-adda-4dd7- 9fb5-d05338526873", rails="solana,xrpl", amount="160", unit="drops", recipient="rKmt...", memo-grammar="X402G:<challenge>", expires="1789860818"

section.name: Client Authorization Header
section.sourcecode: GET /mcp/v1/tools/call HTTP/1.1 Host: api.synapticchain.xyz Authorization: X402-TSWP rail="solana-devnet", tx="4uQ7T...", type="L", memo="X402L:151:1789860218:806384975"

section.name: Payment Receipt Header
section.sourcecode: HTTP/1.1 200 OK X402-Receipt: rail="solana-devnet", leaf="a161f585...", status="settled"

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: Replay attacks are prevented by one-time UUID challenges and the 256-bit sliding window per lane (ADR-062). Byte-exact verification and constant-time comparison mitigate side-channel and injection attacks.

section.name: HTTP Authentication Scheme Registration
section.t: Register "X402-TSWP" in the HTTP Authentication Scheme Registry.

section.name: Header Field Registration
section.t: Register "X402-Receipt" as a permanent dictionary field.
